# Count the number of spiral galaxies and compare with other types
spiral_count = df[df['object type'] == 'spiral galaxy'].shape[0]
other_counts = df[df['object type'] != 'spiral galaxy'].groupby('object type').size()

# Check if spiral galaxies have the highest count
answer = spiral_count > other_counts.max() if len(other_counts) > 0 else True
